The '''Phaeda Planetary Defense Force''' served as the [[Navy/Legends|naval]] forces tasked with [[Planetary Security Forces|protecting]] the [[Phaeda system/Legends|Phaeda system]].

The [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Derapha (cruiser)|''Derapha'']] was a part of the defense force.
